meaning.en: Narada, having approached Brahma
meaning.hi: नारद, ब्रह्मा के पास पहुँचकर

meaning.en: said
meaning.hi: बोले

meaning.en: teach me, Lord
meaning.hi: मुझे सिखाइए, भगवन्

meaning.en: the highest knowledge of Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म का सर्वश्रेष्ठ ज्ञान

meaning.en: by which
meaning.hi: जिसके द्वारा

meaning.en: quickly casting off all wrongdoing
meaning.hi: शीघ्र ही सारे पाप को दूर करके

meaning.en: having gained the knowledge of Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मविद्या पाकर

meaning.en: one becomes rich, full of true abundance
meaning.hi: मनुष्य ऐश्वर्यवान बनता है

meaning.en: Brahma said
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा ने कहा

meaning.en: the mantras belonging to the deity Hayagriva
meaning.hi: हयग्रीव देवता से जुड़े मंत्र

meaning.en: whoever knows
meaning.hi: जो कोई जानता है

meaning.en: he knows the Vedas, the remembered law, the histories, and the Puranas
meaning.hi: वह वेद, स्मृति, इतिहास और पुराणों को जानता है

meaning.en: he becomes rich in every way
meaning.hi: वह सब प्रकार से ऐश्वर्यवान बनता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: here, then, are these mantras
meaning.hi: तो ये रहे वे मंत्र

meaning.en: to the one whose form goes beyond the entire universe
meaning.hi: विश्व से परे स्वरूप वाले को

meaning.en: whose very nature is pure consciousness and bliss
meaning.hi: चेतना और आनंद-स्वरूप वाले को

meaning.en: to you, Hayagriva, I bow
meaning.hi: तुम्हें प्रणाम, हे हयग्रीव

meaning.en: to the king of knowledge
meaning.hi: विद्या के राजा को

meaning.en: svaha, svaha, I bow
meaning.hi: स्वाहा, स्वाहा, प्रणाम

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: to the one whose form is the Rig, Yajur, and Sama Vedas
meaning.hi: ऋग्, यजुः और सामवेद के रूप वाले को

meaning.en: to the one who does the work of drawing out the Vedas
meaning.hi: वेदों को प्रकट करने का कार्य करने वाले को

meaning.en: whose body is the syllable Om and the Udgitha chant
meaning.hi: प्रणव और उद्गीथ रूपी शरीर वाले को

meaning.en: to the great horse-headed one, salutations
meaning.hi: महाश्व-मुख वाले को प्रणाम

meaning.en: svaha, svaha, I bow
meaning.hi: स्वाहा, स्वाहा, प्रणाम

meaning.en: O Udgitha, O Pranava that carries the Udgitha
meaning.hi: हे उद्गीथ, हे प्रणव-उद्गीथ

meaning.en: lord over every lord of speech
meaning.hi: समस्त वाणी के स्वामियों के भी स्वामी

meaning.en: made whole from every Veda, beyond ordinary thought
meaning.hi: समस्त वेदों से बना, चिंतन से परे

meaning.en: awaken all things, awaken them
meaning.hi: सब कुछ जगाओ, जगाओ

meaning.en: svaha, svaha, I bow
meaning.hi: स्वाहा, स्वाहा, प्रणाम

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Brahma, Atri, Vasishtha, and Bhrigu are the sages
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा, अत्रि, वसिष्ठ और भृगु ऋषि हैं

meaning.en: Gayatri, Trishtubh, and Anushtubh are the metres
meaning.hi: गायत्री, त्रिष्टुभ और अनुष्टुभ छंद हैं

meaning.en: glorious Hayagriva, the supreme self, is the deity
meaning.hi: तेजस्वी हयग्रीव, परम आत्मा, देवता हैं

meaning.en: hlaum is the seed sound
meaning.hi: ह्लौं बीज-अक्षर है

meaning.en: "I am that" is the living power
meaning.hi: "सोऽहम्" शक्ति है

meaning.en: hlaum is the anchoring sound
meaning.hi: ह्लौं ही कीलक (अटल ध्वनि) है

meaning.en: its use is for worldly comfort and for final freedom
meaning.hi: भोग और मोक्ष के लिए इसका प्रयोग है

meaning.en: four-armed, holding conch, discus, book, and a hand raised in blessing
meaning.hi: शंख, चक्र, महामुद्रा और पुस्तक से युक्त चार भुजाओं वाला

meaning.en: we meditate on Hayagriva, bright as the full moon
meaning.hi: पूर्ण चंद्रमा के समान हयग्रीव का हम ध्यान करते हैं

meaning.en: Om Shri is two syllables
meaning.hi: ॐ श्री दो अक्षर हैं

meaning.en: hlaum is one syllable
meaning.hi: ह्लौं एक अक्षर है

meaning.en: Om Namo Bhagavate is seven syllables
meaning.hi: ॐ नमो भगवते सात अक्षर हैं

meaning.en: Hayagrivaya is five syllables
meaning.hi: हयग्रीवाय पाँच अक्षर हैं

meaning.en: Vishnave is three syllables
meaning.hi: विष्णवे तीन अक्षर हैं

meaning.en: Mahyam Medham Prajnam is six syllables
meaning.hi: मह्यं मेधां प्रज्ञाम् छह अक्षर हैं

meaning.en: Prayaccha Svaha is five syllables
meaning.hi: प्रयच्छ स्वाहा पाँच अक्षर हैं

meaning.en: this is Hayagriva's mantra in its complete, fourth form
meaning.hi: यह हयग्रीव का तुरीय (चतुर्थ) रूप है

meaning.en: now I will explain the knowledge of Brahman through the single syllable of Hayagriva
meaning.hi: अब मैं हयग्रीव के एक अक्षर से ब्रह्मविद्या बताता हूँ

meaning.en: Brahma gave it to Maheshvara (Shiva)
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मा ने महेश्वर को दिया

meaning.en: Maheshvara gave it to Sankarshana
meaning.hi: महेश्वर ने संकर्षण को दिया

meaning.en: Sankarshana gave it to Narada
meaning.hi: संकर्षण ने नारद को दिया

meaning.en: Narada gave it to Vyasa
meaning.hi: नारद ने व्यास को दिया

meaning.en: Vyasa gave it onward to the world
meaning.hi: व्यास ने इसे संसार को दिया

meaning.en: the three sounds ha, sa, ma merge into a single form
meaning.hi: ह, स, म — ये तीनों मिलकर एक रूप बनते हैं

meaning.en: hlaum is the seed syllable
meaning.hi: ह्लौं बीज-अक्षर है

meaning.en: those who chant it gain both prosperity and mastery over speech
meaning.hi: इसे जपने वालों को समृद्धि और वाणी दोनों प्राप्त होते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever understands this teaching gains the liberation that Vaidehi (Sita) attained
meaning.hi: जो यह समझता है वह वही मुक्ति पाता है जो विदेही (सीता) ने पाई

words.sanskrit: dikpalanam rajnam naganam kinnaranam adhipatir bhavati

meaning.en: it grants mastery over the guardians of the directions, kings, serpent-beings, and kinnaras
meaning.hi: यह दिशा-रक्षकों, राजाओं, नागों और किन्नरों पर अधिकार देता है

meaning.en: through the discipline of chanting Hayagriva's single syllable
meaning.hi: हयग्रीव के एक अक्षर के जप-अनुशासन से

meaning.en: the sun and other heavenly bodies keep faithfully to their own courses
meaning.hi: सूर्य आदि स्वयं अपने-अपने कार्य में निष्ठा से प्रवृत्त रहते हैं

words.sanskrit: sarvesham bijanam hayagrivaikakshara-bijam anuttamam mantra-rajatmakam bhavati

meaning.en: among all seed sounds, this one syllable of Hayagriva is the greatest, the king among mantras
meaning.hi: सभी बीजों में हयग्रीव का यह अक्षर सर्वश्रेष्ठ है, मंत्रों का राजा है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: hlaum is Hayagriva's own form
meaning.hi: ह्लौं हयग्रीव का स्वयं का स्वरूप है

meaning.en: grant me the deathless, grant it, svaha
meaning.hi: मुझे अमरता दो, दो, स्वाहा

words.sanskrit: tajjapakanam vak-siddhih shri-siddhih ashtanga-yoga-siddhish cha bhavati

meaning.en: those who chant it gain mastery over speech, radiance, and success in eight-limbed yoga
meaning.hi: जपने वालों को वाक्-सिद्धि, श्री-सिद्धि और अष्टांग-योग-सिद्धि प्राप्त होती है

meaning.en: grant success over the whole of existence, grant it, svaha
meaning.hi: संपूर्ण अस्तित्व पर सिद्धि दो, दो, स्वाहा

words.sanskrit: tan etan mantran yo veda apavitrah pavitro bhavati

meaning.en: whoever knows these mantras, even if impure, becomes pure
meaning.hi: जो इन मंत्रों को जानता है, अपवित्र होते हुए भी पवित्र हो जाता है

meaning.en: one who has failed in discipline becomes truly disciplined
meaning.hi: अब्रह्मचारी सुब्रह्मचारी बन जाता है

meaning.en: contact with what should be avoided is washed clean
meaning.hi: जिस संपर्क से बचना था उससे भी शुद्धि मिलती है

meaning.en: even speaking with someone fallen from grace is washed clean
meaning.hi: पतित से बात करने की भूल भी धुल जाती है

meaning.en: a person is freed even from grave wrongs like harming a teacher
meaning.hi: गुरु-हत्या जैसे भारी पापों से भी मुक्ति मिलती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: griham grihapatir iva dehi dehante paramatmanam pravishati

meaning.en: as the lord of a house enters his own inner room, the self enters the supreme self at the body's end
meaning.hi: जैसे घर का स्वामी अपने भीतरी कक्ष में प्रवेश करता है, वैसे ही देह के अंत में आत्मा परमात्मा में प्रवेश करती है

meaning.en: consciousness and bliss are Brahman
meaning.hi: चेतना और आनंद ही ब्रह्म हैं

meaning.en: you are that
meaning.hi: तू वही है

meaning.en: this self is Brahman
meaning.hi: यह आत्मा ब्रह्म है

words.sanskrit: aham brahmasmi iti mahavakyaih pratipaditam artham

meaning.en: I am Brahman — the meaning taught by these great declarations
meaning.hi: मैं ब्रह्म हूँ — इन महावाक्यों द्वारा सिखाया गया अर्थ

meaning.en: these mantras teach that same truth
meaning.hi: ये मंत्र भी वही सत्य सिखाते हैं

meaning.en: divided into two kinds by vowels and consonants
meaning.hi: स्वर और व्यंजन के भेद से दो प्रकार के

meaning.en: then one quietly repeats the mantras that follow
meaning.hi: फिर आगे के मंत्रों को शांत भाव से जपता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: that speech which speaks the truths unthinking creatures cannot voice
meaning.hi: वह वाणी जो अचेतन प्राणी नहीं कह सकते, वही कहती है

meaning.en: the sweet-voiced ruler seated among the gods
meaning.hi: देवताओं के बीच विराजमान मधुर-स्वर वाली शासिका

meaning.en: she draws out nourishment and strength in four forms
meaning.hi: वह चार रूपों में पोषण और शक्ति खींचती है

meaning.en: where, in the end, does her highest reach arrive?
meaning.hi: उसकी सबसे ऊँची पहुँच अंततः कहाँ जाती है?

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. This verse and the three that follow are archaic Vedic hymn-Sanskrit (a Vak-sukta fragment) and read as poetry rather than plain prose.

meaning.en: Gauri calls out and the waters take shape
meaning.hi: गौरी पुकारती है और जल आकार लेता है

meaning.en: one-footed, two-footed, then four-footed
meaning.hi: एक-पद, दो-पद, फिर चार-पद

meaning.en: becoming eight-footed, nine-footed
meaning.hi: आठ-पद, नौ-पद बनती हुई

meaning.en: a thousand-syllabled form in the farthest reach of space
meaning.hi: हज़ार अक्षरों वाला रूप, अंतरिक्ष की सबसे दूर पहुँच में

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Archaic Vedic hymn-Sanskrit; this line is among the most cryptic in the source hymn and admits more than one traditional reading.

meaning.en: whose lips form a covering
meaning.hi: जिसके ओष्ठ एक आवरण बनाते हैं

meaning.en: encircled by teeth like a hidden thunderbolt
meaning.hi: दाँतों से घिरी, वज्र की तरह

meaning.en: the ruling power over every kind of speech
meaning.hi: हर प्रकार की वाणी की शासिका

meaning.en: she says: speak through me here, beautifully
meaning.hi: वह कहती है: यहाँ मेरे माध्यम से बोलो, सुंदरता से

meaning.en: and this is the very essence of speech
meaning.hi: और यही वाणी का सार है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Archaic Vedic hymn-Sanskrit.

meaning.en: holding back the creeping forces that trouble the mind
meaning.hi: मन को व्याकुल करने वाली रेंगती शक्तियों को थामते हुए

meaning.en: she brought forth this vast teaching, given by Jamadagni
meaning.hi: उसने यह विशाल शिक्षा प्रकट की, जमदग्नि द्वारा दी गई

meaning.en: she stretches it across the wrongs bound up with the sun's own light
meaning.hi: वह इसे सूर्य के प्रकाश से बँधे दोषों तक फैलाती है

meaning.en: among the gods it is heard as nectar that never ages
meaning.hi: देवताओं में यह कभी न बूढ़ा होने वाले अमृत की तरह सुनी जाती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. Archaic Vedic hymn-Sanskrit; this closing line is genuinely difficult and traditional commentators differ on parts of its reading.
